\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\ipm}{\pm i}
\newcommand{\Epm}{E_{\pm}}
\begin{document}
Let $x$ be real.
\begin{equation}
e^{\ipm x} = \cos x \ipm \sin x
\label{eq:m1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\cosh x \pm \sinh x = e^{\pm x}
\label{eq:m2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
e^{\ipm x} = \cos x - i\sin x
\label{eq:m3}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
